Priya (CS): Quick notes from Ellipsis onboarding: finance can't reconcile invoices without per-route detail. They asked for an on-demand CSV export and a sample GL mapping before renewal.
Evan (PM): please paste exact columns they want so we can spec an MVP.
Priya (CS): they listed: account_id,project_id,route,route_id,model,requests,tokens,token_cost,currency_code,normalized_cost,period_start,period_end,cost_center. Also asked for an example row with EUR values.
Luis (Eng): sounds fine. Do they want scheduled drops (S3/SFTP) or ad-hoc first?
Priya (CS): ad-hoc download now, schedule SFTP as follow-up. They said lack of visibility is a top renewal risk.
Nora (Product): prioritize export as P1 (renewal risk), scheduled/SFTP = P2, per-team default model toggle = P2.
Evan (PM): agree. Benchtop spec: GET /accounts/{id}/billing/exports/{id} returning text/csv. Include currency_code and normalized_cost column in the CSV.
Luis (Eng): estimate for MVP (on-demand CSV + minimal UI trigger): 5 dev-days + 2 QA days. SFTP adds infra work. We'll include sample headers and a sample CSV row in the ticket.
CS-Bot: Ticket CS-6123 created: "Ellipsis per-route billing export" tags=[billing,export,renewal-risk].
Priya (CS): Enablement asks: 20-30 minute finance walkthrough + one-pager mapping CSV columns -> GL codes and note on currency normalization. I'll schedule once beta is ready.
Evan (PM): add enablement checklist to CS-6123: spec, demo build, one-pager, walkthrough scheduling. Also add success metric: % of renewal accounts that download CSV within 14 days.
Nora (Product): small UX ask from the call: default lower-cost model per-team (dropdown in team settings). Low-effort, tag as P2.
Luis (Eng): will create separate PR for default-model toggle and spec endpoint for CSV. Adding currency_code to sample.
Priya (CS): final ask from customer: include a sample mapping row showing token_cost -> currency and their GL code. I'll attach their sample GL sheet to the ticket.
Evan (PM): timeline proposal: spec in ticket by Wed EOD, eng tickets by next Mon, beta demo within 10 business days.
Luis (Eng): noted. Ping me in CS-6123 for any schema clarifications.
Priya (CS): thanks all 44D I'll follow up with Ellipsis to confirm walkthrough windows and share the ticket links.
CS-Bot: Reaction: :white_check_mark:
